purpose: Teach: 排斥/テロリズム/美化/道義/加担/横領/危害/儒教

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時下の少数民族排斥を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper examined minority persecution during wartime, didn't it?
lines.style: Steady, attentive opening. Genuine curiosity layered beneath the professorial tone. Slight upward lift on the name — welcoming him into the conversation. No edge.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、国際テロリズム対策史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on the history of international counterterrorism efforts.
lines.style: Careful, precise. A small hesitation before the correction, as if weighing the words. Respectful but not deferential. Looking directly at her.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、歴史記述の美化問題を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper dealt with the problem of historical whitewashing, then?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before the question. Not testing him — genuinely seeking to understand his framing. Warm but measured. She leans in slightly, listening.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、近代の道義的判断の哲学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined the philosophy of moral judgment in the modern period.
lines.style: Quiet precision. A breath before he speaks, as if he's thought about this exact phrasing. Earnest without apology. His shoulders settle slightly as he explains.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 組織犯罪に加担した内部者の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: So your paper touched on insiders complicit in organized crime?
lines.style: Engaged and present. The question lands with gentle intention — she's tracking his work carefully. No judgment in her voice, only recognition of the weight of the subject.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、企業横領事件の社会的影響を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I looked at the social impact of corporate embezzlement scandals.
lines.style: Direct but soft. He's correcting gently, not defensively. The precision matters to him. A slight tightening around the eyes as he speaks — concentrating on accuracy.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、市民に危害を加えた事案を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper examined cases where civilians were harmed, correct?
lines.style: Slower, more deliberate. A gentle inquiry beneath the surface question. She's giving him space to clarify — not pushing, inviting. Her voice carries the weight of understanding why this distinction matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、東アジアの儒教思想史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I concentrated on the intellectual history of Confucian thought in East Asia.
lines.style: Quiet but steadier now. The final correction. He speaks with quiet conviction, as if this framing has mattered all along. Small smile at the corner — a gentle closing.
